dimensions.note: No secrets handled; SSH defers to the user's agent/ssh_config with BatchMode=yes.
Structured logger placeholders; findings and lcp fallbacks logged.

Non-zero exit, vppctl unknown input (exit 0), socket errors, missing binary and timeouts become clear errors naming node and command. health tolerates a missing linux-cp plugin; show hardware-interfaces brief may fail (link state then omitted). Counter rate uses 1 s when the interval is unknown.

27 tests in test/: parsers on real VPP 26.10 fixtures plus synthetic 26.06 snippets (threads lcore layout, hardware brief), counter classification and rates, link-down suppression, deltas, truncation, refusal, failure paths. Live: lab container (26.10) and an edge router over SSH with sudo (26.06).
Read-only; counter deltas handle cleared counters (cur < prev).
No HTTP. vppctl output formats checked against VPP 26.10; parsers skip unknown lines.
Each call has an AbortSignal (run signal + per-call timeout) passed to Deno.Command; stdin is null.
Docs use RFC 5737/3849 addresses and example.net; router-derived test snippets contain only generic interface names, no real addresses; fixtures are outside the archive.
Every resource field declared; new linkUp/linkSpeed (interfaces) and linkDown (health) are written; schema-write conformance rechecked.
infinite lifetime with version GC (5-50); raw show output 30d/10.
Diagnostics only, every method is kind read by design.
All methods are kind read, so checks would not run.
version/lcp/interfaces/errors shared by their method and health with the same schema; fib/neighbors/show names include family, table, prefix, interface or command slug.
readResource used for previous interfaces/errors to compute deltas; failures fall back to no delta.
Behavior 2026.11.25.1 -> 2026.11.25.3 with a no-op upgrade (globalArguments unchanged); verified an existing instance moved from upgradable to current.
